thig12.1:1.1: udakahārī ahaṃ sīte sadā udakam otariṃ | ayyānaṃ daṇḍabhayabhītā vācādosabhayadditā. || ||
thig12.1:2.1: kassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ bhīto sadā udakam otari | vedhamānehi gattehi sītaṃ vedayase bhusaṃ. || ||
thig12.1:3.1: jānantī ca tuvaṃ bhoti Puṇṇike paripucchasi | karontaṃ kusalaṃ kammaṃ rudhantaṃ kamma pāpakaṃ. || ||
thig12.1:4.1: yo ca vuḍḍho vā dabaro vā pāpakammaṃ pakubbati | udakābhisecanā so pi pāpakammā pamuccati. || ||
thig12.1:5.1: ko nu te idam akkhāsi ajānantassa ajānato | udakābhisecanā nāma pāpakammā pamuccati || ||
thig12.1:6.1: saggaṃ nūna gamissanti sabbe maṇḍūkakacchapā | nāgā ca suṃsumārā ca ye c' aññe udakecarā. || ||
thig12.1:7.1: orabbhikā sūkarikā macchikā migabandhakā | corā ca vajjhaghātā ca ye c' aññe pāpakammino | udakābhisecanā te pi pāpakammā pamuccare. || ||
thig12.1:8.1: sace imā nadiyo te pāpaṃ pubbekataṃ vaheyyuṃ | puññaṃ p' imā vaheyyuṃ tena tvaṃ paribāhiro assa. || ||
thig12.1:9.1: yassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ bhīto sadā udakam otari | tam eva brahme mā kāsi mā te sītaṃ chaviṃ hane. || ||
thig12.1:10.1: kumaggaṃ paṭipannaṃ maṃ ariyamaggaṃ samānayi | udakābhisecanaṃ bhoti imaṃ sāṭaṃ dadāmi te. || ||
thig12.1:11.1: tuyh' eva sāṭako hotu nāham icchāmi sāṭakaṃ. | sace bhāyasi dukkhassa sace te dukkhaṃ appiyaṃ || ||
thig12.1:12.1: mā kāsi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ āvi vā yadi vā raho. | sace ca pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karissasi karosi vā || ||
thig12.1:13.1: na te dukkhā pamuty atthi upeccāpi palāyato. | sace bhāyasi dukkhassa sace te dukkham appiyaṃ || ||
thig12.1:14.1: upehi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṅghañ ca tādinaṃ | samādiyāhi sīlāni tan te atthāya hehiti. || ||
thig12.1:15.1: upemi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ saṅghañ ca tādinaṃ | samādiyāmi sīlāni taṃ me atthāya hehiti. || ||
thig12.1:16.1: brahmabandhu pure āsiṃ ajj' amhi saccaṃ brāhmaṇo | tevijjo vedasampanno sotthiyo c' amhi nhātako. || || Puṇṇikā. ||
